evidence_quotes: Since we first wrote about preparing for the move from VBScript to BSL , three things have changed: Oracle has revised the timeline, Oracle has started shipping BSL-specific fixes in consecutive quarterly patches, and inlumi has taken customers through the migration — completing some, with others still in progress.
